thread:
Maya Rao: Drafting a migration plan for major model upgrades. Goal: minimize customer disruption, keep latency/cost stable, and provide clear rollback lanes. Sharing a proposed phased rollout + decision gates — please review and flag gaps. 

Ben Cook: Looks good. Quick q: how are we defining pin/unpin semantics during the rollout? hard pin for enterprise customers?

Sofia Li: Technical proposal: incremental canary cohorts + automatic metrics gating. Example rollout script (pseudo):
```
canary: 1% traffic -> 24h
if pass -> 5% -> 48h
if pass -> 25% -> 72h
if pass -> 100%
metrics: latency P95, generation quality (eval set A), error rate
rollback: immediate to previous-pinned-version on fail
```

Priya Singh: We need explicit benchmark thresholds. My suggestion: quality delta <= 1% drop on eval A, P95 latency change <= 10%, error rate <= 0.1%. Collection window: 24–72h per stage.

Carlos Martinez: For paying customers we should offer an opt-in early-adopter toggle and an SLA-backed rollback window. Also notify affected customers 48h before canary.

Ben Cook: Proposed risk matrix (quick):
- High: silent data corruption / hallucination increase -> block rollout, mandatory rollback + incident postmortem
- Medium: 10–20% latency increase -> canary hold + perf tuning
- Low: minor quality variance (<1%) -> monitor and proceed
Mitigations: pinning policy, automatic fallback routing, customer opt-out.

Maya Rao: Ownership ask: can Ben own rollout infra + safeguards, Sofia owns evaluation and metrics, Priya owns benchmark thresholds and data collection, Carlos handles comms. Launch criteria I want in checklist form: metrics pass, incident runbook ready, comms scheduled, legal/compliance sign-off for regulated customers.

catalog-bot: New model version v3.2.0 added to catalog by @Sofia Li at 1861234572. Auto-generated preview metrics available.

Sofia Li: Note: we need a compatibility shim for kv-cache format and quantized kernels. Runtime fallback will return 503-less graceful degrade by routing to last-stable variant to avoid customer-facing errors.

Priya Singh: Suggest evaluation minimums: either 3 days of live canary traffic OR 50k calls, whichever hits first. Also collect prompt/response pairs for manual QA sampling.

Carlos Martinez: Also flag enterprise customers on Dedicated and Private who require pre-approval. I'll send a targeted list and suggested communication copy.

Maya Rao: Great. Action items: Ben (infra safeguards + rollback automation) - due EOD Tue, Sofia (eval harness + compatibility tests) - due Wed, Priya (threshold docs + data retention) - due Wed, Carlos (customer list + comms draft) - due Thu. We'll reconvene Fri 10am to lock launch gates. :thumbsup:
